1.w: A song of ascents. O Lord , for David’s sake remember all his strenuous effort

2.w: and how he made a vow to the Lord , and swore an oath to the Powerful One of Jacob.

3.w: He said, “I will not enter my own home, or get into my bed.

4.w: I will not allow my eyes to sleep or my eyelids to slumber,

5.w: until I find a place for the Lord , a fine dwelling place for the Powerful One of Jacob.”

6.w: Look, we heard about it in Ephrathah; we found it in the territory of Jaar.

7.w: Let us go to his dwelling place. Let us worship before his footstool.

8.w: Ascend, O Lord , to your resting place, you and the ark of your strength.

9.w: May your priests be clothed with integrity. May your loyal followers shout for joy.

10.w: For the sake of David, your servant, do not reject your chosen king.

11.w: The Lord made a reliable promise to David; he will not go back on his word. He said, “I will place one of your descendants on your throne.

12.w: If your sons keep my covenant and the rules I teach them, their sons will also sit on your throne forever.”

13.w: Certainly the Lord has chosen Zion; he decided to make it his home.

14.w: He said, “This will be my resting place forever; I will live here, for I have chosen it.

15.w: I will abundantly supply what she needs; I will give her poor all the food they need.

16.w: I will protect her priests, and her godly people will shout exuberantly.

17.w: There I will make David strong; I have determined that my chosen king’s dynasty will continue.

18.w: I will humiliate his enemies, and his crown will shine.”
